FEAT-6-S153.title: Consent Data Schema & Persistence Model
FEAT-6-S153.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema for consent records including tier level, timestamps, session linkage, and audit fields to support HIPAA compliance and enforcement.

FEAT-6-S154.title: Consent Validation Middleware
FEAT-6-S154.description: Implement reusable backend middleware/service layer that validates consent tier before any data persistence or external API calls involving PHI, enabling consistent enforcement across services.

FEAT-6-S155.title: Consent Audit Logging
FEAT-6-S155.description: Capture audit logs for all consent actions (grant, deny, escalate, enforce) including metadata for traceability and compliance review.

FEAT-6-S156.title: Consent Workflow Unit & Integration Tests
FEAT-6-S156.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering consent tier transitions, enforcement logic, de-identification behavior, and API responses to ensure correctness and prevent regression.
